parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file belongs to the infrastructure layer, and everything in it is persistence-adapter work. It defines three in-memory repositories, each backed by a Map, that implement repository interfaces declared in the domain layer. Each one only stores entities and looks them up by id. InMemoryTaskRepository.findByProject also filters tasks by projectId and by optional status and assigneeId values from a TaskFilter. That filter is the shape the domain interface asks for, so the method is a storage query, not a business rule. The file has no invariants, state transitions, authorization or other business logic, and no transport or presentation code.
